summary_for_children: Fatir means The Originator. It praises Allah who created the heavens and the earth and shows signs in colours: fruits, mountains, people and animals of every colour, and fresh and salty seas.
environment_concept: A land of colour: fruits of many colours, white and red mountain streaks, black rock, and two seas giving food and ornaments.
architecture_and_scenery: Striped mountains, orchards, pearl beaches, and a sky streaked with wings of light suggested only by colour, never angels.

palette.lighting: Bright clear daylight to show colour

areas.name: Streaked Mountains
areas.description: Mountains with white, red and black streaks.

areas.name: Two Seas
areas.description: Fresh and salt seas with pearls and fish.

activities.name: Colour hunt
activities.description: Collect colours from fruits, rocks and animals.
activities.label: artistic educational adaptation, not an event in the Quran

activities.name: Pearl diving
activities.label: artistic educational adaptation, not an event in the Quran

narration_plan: Narration celebrates colour and links knowledge with awe of Allah (35:28).

status.playable_environment: not built: a shared symbolic setting stands in

depiction_rules: No prophet, person or representation of Allah is shown. Unseen realities are never pictured. Interactive activities are labelled as adaptations.
